facts.name: Hims & Hers Health
sentences: Hims & Hers Health's shares moved 5% or more on 71 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 29 July 2026, when the stock fell 14.7%.
The stock is down 29.4% this year, and at $22.94 it sits 44.1% below its 52-week closing high of $41.05 from 10 November 2025.
$1,000 invested in Hims & Hers Health five years ago would be worth $2,771 today.
